1164-4740-6123-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 16 or higher.
1164-4740-6123-6900.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Necrodominance, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Gwenom.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
1164-4740-6123-6900.notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

955-2023-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1303-3249-6006--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1303-3249-6006--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5670-6792-7918--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6792-7918--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from the persist creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.

23-662-1651-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Vandal to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Orcish Vandal by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Vandal.
Repeat from step 2.

880-6763-7705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6763-7705.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

165-1069-1169-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-1169-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7184.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ferrafor, adding {C}{C}.
When Ferrafor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ferrafor from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ferrafor enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2416-3062-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2416-3899-3921-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-5517-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
1978-5517-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat

1681-2921-4140.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

290-869-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Dreamstone Hedron by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Dreamstone Hedron.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1479-3703-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3703-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2724-3080-4428-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

719-1247-5832.notablePrerequisites:
Joraga Treespeaker has at least five level counters on it.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
719-1247-5832.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

236-478-804-2821-4249.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
236-478-804-2821-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
236-478-804-2821-4249.description:
Animate Candelabra using Bring to Life
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

1461-4050-4078-4716.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-4050-4078-4716.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-2527-4170-4549.notablePrerequisites:
Fain is not your commander.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
Your commander is on the battlefield and does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2527-4170-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping your commander, adding {B}.
Your commander triggers, giving it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing your commander, adding {C}{C}.
When your commander dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing the +1/+1 counter from your commander, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping it.
Repeat.

495-500-851-4688-4751.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nested Shambler.
495-500-851-4688-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting at least nine +1/+1 counters on Nested Shambler, and the remaining seven +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Kill Nested Shambler, triggering its ability, creating at least twenty 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

914-1368-2555-4856.notablePrerequisites:
If Dockside Extortionist and/or Brain Freeze are in your graveyard, you have an additional three cards in your graveyard for each one.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1368-2555-4856.description:
If Dockside Extortionist is in your hand, cast it by paying {1}{R}.
Otherwise, cast it from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard except Brain Freeze.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Death Match.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Death Match trigger, giving Dockside Extortionist -3/-3 until end of turn.
Dockside Extortionist dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
If Brain Freeze is in your hand, cast it by paying {1}{U}.
Otherwise, cast it from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard except Dockside Extortionist.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, creating a copy of Brain Freeze for each other spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first two Brain Freezes, causing you to mill six cards.
Resolve all remaining Brain Freezes, causing target player to mill three cards for each Brain Freeze.
Repeat.

628-2034-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 until Deathbringer Thoctar has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Deathbringer Thoctar, adding {C}{C}.
Deathbringer Thoctar dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

900-3398.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Feast and Famine attached to Hellkite Charger.
You control lands that can produce at least {5}{R}{R}.
Opponents cannot block Hellkite Charger.
900-3398.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker.
Hellkite Charger triggers.
In response, activate lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve Hellkite Charger's trigger, paying {5}{R}{R} to gain an extra combat phase and untap all attacking creatures you control.
When Hellkite Charger deals combat damage, Sword of Feast and Famine triggers, untapping all lands you control and causing the defending player to discard a card.
Repeat.

1987-2510-3227-4714.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3227-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.

813-1964-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
813-1964-1987-2510.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
